classic.name: query_database
classic.title: Query Database
classic.description: Execute a SQL query subject to the active database policy

format.description: How the rows are rendered: 'map' (default, one object per row) or 'columnar' (the column names once and every row an array of values in that order).

max_cell_bytes.description: Cell size budget in bytes (16..1048576; default and server ceiling 1048576). Longer values are shortened and marked. The SQL is never rewritten.

max_response_bytes.description: Approximate result budget in bytes (512..8388608; default and server ceiling 8388608). The result stops there and is marked as truncated.

query.description: SQL query to execute. The server validates the active read-only, whitelist and approval policy.

classic.name: get_database_info
classic.title: Get Database Info
classic.description: Get database connection status and basic information

classic.name: explore
classic.title: Explore Database
classic.description: Explore database objects. type=tables (default) lists tables/views, type=views lists views with metadata (check_option, is_updatable, definition preview), type=databases lists all databases, type=procedures lists stored procedures, type=search searches objects by name, by source definition (requires pattern) or by column name (requires pattern).

filter.description: Name filter for tables/procedures (LIKE match, e.g. 'Pedido')

limit.description: Maximum number of results for type=search (default 50, max 200). A truncated result is reported with truncated=true.

max_cell_bytes.description: Cell size budget in bytes (16..1048576; default and server ceiling 1048576). Longer values are shortened and marked. The SQL is never rewritten.

max_response_bytes.description: Approximate result budget in bytes (512..8388608; default and server ceiling 8388608). The result stops there and is marked as truncated.

schema.description: Schema filter for procedures, and for a column search (exact schema name)

search_in.description: Where to search: 'name' (default), 'definition' (inside procedure/view source code), 'column' (columns whose name contains the term)

table.description: Table filter for a column search (literal substring match)

classic.name: inspect
classic.title: Inspect Table
classic.description: Inspect a table's structure. detail=columns (default) returns column info, detail=indexes returns indexes, detail=foreign_keys returns FK relationships, detail=dependencies returns objects (views, procedures, functions) that reference this table, detail=all returns everything in one call.

max_cell_bytes.description: Cell size budget in bytes (16..1048576; default and server ceiling 1048576). Longer values are shortened and marked. The SQL is never rewritten.

max_response_bytes.description: Approximate result budget in bytes (512..8388608; default and server ceiling 8388608). The result stops there and is marked as truncated.

table_name.description: Name of the table (can include schema: 'dbo.TableName')

classic.name: execute_procedure
classic.title: Execute Procedure
classic.description: Execute a whitelisted stored procedure (requires MSSQL_WHITELIST_PROCEDURES env var)

parameters.description: JSON object with parameter names and values (optional)

procedure_name.description: Name of the stored procedure to execute

classic.name: explain_query
classic.title: Explain Query
classic.description: Show the estimated execution plan for a SQL query without executing it. Useful for performance analysis and query optimization. Only SELECT queries are accepted.

query.description: SELECT query to analyze (must be a read-only query)

dynamic.name: dynamic_available
dynamic.title: List Dynamic Connections
dynamic.description: List all preconfigured dynamic database connections (aliases defined via MSSQL_DYNAMIC_<ALIAS>_* environment variables). Does not expose credentials. Use dynamic_connect to activate one.

dynamic.name: dynamic_connect
dynamic.title: Connect to Dynamic Alias
dynamic.description: Switch the active database connection to one of the preconfigured dynamic aliases (e.g. 'CRM', 'IDENTITY', 'GDP'). The security posture (read-only vs full access) is determined by the alias configuration or global safe defaults. After connecting, use get_database_info to verify the active alias and its effective permissions.

alias.description: The alias name of the preconfigured connection (case-insensitive, e.g. 'CRM' or 'crm')

dynamic.name: dynamic_disconnect
dynamic.title: Disconnect Dynamic Connection
dynamic.description: Close the currently active dynamic connection and return to disconnected state. Does not affect other aliases.

dynamic.name: dynamic_list
dynamic.title: List Active Dynamic Connections
dynamic.description: Show currently loaded dynamic aliases and which one (if any) is the active connection for subsequent query_database calls.

dynamic.name: confirm_operation
dynamic.title: Confirm Dangerous Operation
dynamic.description: Explicitly confirm a potentially destructive operation (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DROP/etc.) on a writable dynamic alias. This is a required security step. You must call this tool with a clear description of what you intend to do before the actual modification query will be allowed.

description.description: Clear description of the operation you want to perform (e.g. 'DELETE all rows from temp_ai where created < 2025-01-01')
